- caller provides a `loop_id` field -> reject;
- registry provides a different DURABLE ChatGPT/Semi-Auto/Jules loop_id -> reject;
- registry remains PLACEHOLDER -> reject;
- origin_loop_id, human Loop number, command_id, correlation_id, session id, PR number, branch, or target head resembles the stable ID -> none may change the canonical ID;
- malformed/unsafe canonical identity must fail existing path validation rather than being accepted;
- duplicate enabled ChatGPT/Semi-Auto/Jules registry lanes remain fail-closed;

- PLACEHOLDER production registry still yields NOT_WIRED/rejection.
